title: Machine-learning-guided transcriptomic integration identifies GFM1 as a lactylation-related candidate biomarker in aortic dissection.
authors: Chen, Junquan; Jiang, Nan; Guo, Zhigang; Bai, Yunpeng
one_liner_zh: 该文利用机器学习整合转录组数据筛选主动脉夹层中乳酸化相关生物标志物GFM1，仅涉及基因表达与细胞表型实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Aortic dissection (AD) is a life-threatening aortic disease with limited disease-modifying pharmacologic options. Lysine lactylation is a metabolism-linked post-translational modification implicated in vascular and inflammatory biology, but its relationship to AD has not been well characterized. Public AD transcriptomic datasets were integrated for differential expression analysis and WGCNA. Lactylation-related DEGs were defined by intersecting DEGs with a curated lactylation-related gene set. Candidate genes were prioritized using complementary machine-learning models (LASSO, Random Forest, and XGBoost) as a feature-screening strategy with internal resampling and hold-out validation (cross-validation and a hold-out set). GFM1 expression was assessed by qRT-PCR and western blotting in human aortic tissues. Functional relevance was examined in primary mouse aortic vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs) using siRNA knockdown under angiotensin II stimulation (1.0 micromol/L, 24 h), with proliferation and migration assessed by CCK-8, EdU, Transwell, and scratch-wound assays. We identified 217 DEGs and an AD-associated co-expression module. Intersection analysis yielded 11 lactylation-related DEGs, among which GFM1 received consistent support across models. GFM1 showed higher expression in AD tissues, and GFM1 knockdown attenuated angiotensin II-induced VSMCs proliferation and migration. Integrated transcriptomics and machine-learning-based prioritization nominate GFM1 as a lactylation-related candidate associated with AD, warranting further investigation. These findings are hypothesis-generating: model performance reflects internal evaluation only, and independent external validation and direct lactylation profiling are required to establish generalizability and clarify mechanistic links.
abstract_zh: 主动脉夹层（aortic dissection, AD）是一种危及生命的主动脉疾病，目前可用的疾病修饰药物选择有限。赖氨酸乳酰化（lysine lactylation）是一种与代谢相关的翻译后修饰，参与血管和炎症生物学过程，但其与AD的关系尚未得到充分表征。整合公共AD转录组数据集进行差异表达分析和WGCNA分析。通过将差异表达基因（DEGs）与精选的乳酰化相关基因集取交集，定义了乳酰化相关DEGs。使用互补的机器学习模型（LASSO、随机森林和XGBoost）作为特征筛选策略，结合内部重采样和留出验证（交叉验证和留出集），对候选基因进行优先级排序。通过qRT-PCR和western blotting评估人主动脉组织中GFM1的表达。在原代小鼠主动脉血管平滑肌细胞（VSMCs）中，使用siRNA敲低并在血管紧张素II刺激（1.0微摩尔/升，24小时）下检查功能相关性，通过CCK-8、EdU、Transwell和划痕实验评估增殖和迁移。我们鉴定了217个DEGs和一个与AD相关的共表达模块。交集分析得到11个乳酰化相关DEGs，其中GFM1在各模型中均获得一致支持。GFM1在AD组织中表达较高，且GFM1敲低减弱了血管紧张素II诱导的VSMCs增殖和迁移。整合转录组学和基于机器学习的优先级排序将GFM1确定为与AD相关的乳酰化候选基因，值得进一步研究。这些发现具有假设生成性质：模型性能仅反映内部评估，需要独立的外部验证和直接的乳酰化谱分析以确立普适性并阐明机制联系。
